annotations.title: Outline the structure of a large JSON payload

description: Use when you are about to read a big JSON response, log or export into context, before loading it: returns a compact outline of the structure (keys, types, array lengths, one example per repeated shape) so you can plan a query without spending tokens on the whole document. Repairs the JSON first if needed. Follow with mend_query_json to pull only the values you need. Up to 100,000 characters.

max_depth.description: How many levels to expand. Default 4.

max_items.description: How many array items to show when items differ. Default 6.

name: mend_outline_json
title: Outline the structure of a large JSON payload
